name: The Smoker
source:
The Smoker is older, sharper, and far more dangerous than he lets on. A fixture of the city itself, his presence felt in every district and among every kind of crowd, he drifts between worlds with the ease of someone who knows exactly how they're all connected. His network runs deep and wide, touching everything from the gambling dens of the East End to the private salons of the Upper Quarters, and nobody is quite sure where his true allegiance lies.

[From the in-game profile]
